versions.changelog:
- 修正了脚本路径，统一为 skills/invoice-discern/invoice-discern.py
- 所有使用方式中的调用路径已同步更新
- 其余内容保持不变

Initial release with HuiSuiYun invoice recognition API integration.

- Supports automatic extraction of invoice information from image, PDF, OFD, or ZIP files.
- Recognizes various invoice types (VAT, vehicle, train ticket, flight itinerary, etc.).
- Returns structured details, including amount, purchaser/seller info, and line items.
- Requires configuration of HSY_AK and HSY_SK environment variables.
- Provides detailed error messages and user guidance if configuration is missing.
